context: Compose a poem all in lowercase letters about my friend Barnet.

trace.content:
barnet walks with quiet feet,
a map of stories on his face.
he knows the way the light bends
when summer turns to autumn grace.

we sit and watch the clouds drift by,
no need for words to fill the space.
just barnet, steady as the tide,
a gentle, constant, warm embrace.

he laughs at things we cannot see,
a secret kept within his chest.
my friend, my guide, my constant star,
the one who puts my mind to rest.
